title: MD Helicopters opens order books for MD 564
summary: The next evolution of the 500-series pairs long-light performance with short-light operating economics.
body_markdown:
MD Helicopters, LLC today introduced the MD 564, the next evolution of its 500-series light single, and opened the MD 564 Early Production Position Reservation Program to operators worldwide.


The MD 564 is a 530F-derived airframe carrying a six-blade fully articulated main rotor, a four-blade tail rotor, and the 600-shp Rolls-Royce 250-C47.


Initial performance calculations include a 4,750-pound maximum gross weight with external load, a 2,500-pound cargo hook capacity, 414 nm range with four-hour endurance on main and auxiliary fuel, hover out of ground effect at maximum takeoff weight up to 14,500 feet, a 27.5-foot main rotor diameter, and a operating cost of less than $900 per flight.


“Operators told us what they wanted: The 500-series they already trust, with more lift and more margin,” said Ryan Weeks, chief executive officer of MD Helicopters.


“The MD 564 is that aircraft, and the early response to the reservation book tells us we’re building the right machine.”


The aircraft is aimed at the work operators currently split across two fleets: Utility line construction and patrol, wildland fire support, law enforcement, search-and-rescue, and remote cargo.


Under the reservation program, production positions are assigned in the order signed agreements and cleared deposits are received.


Deposits are fully refundable until a purchase agreement is executed. Following FAA certification, position holders convert their reservations to purchase agreements in sequence.


“Every operator conversation starts with the same math,” said Luis Trejo, senior director of business development.


“Long-light performance at short-light operating cost changes what one airframe can cover on a certificate. Reserving a production position is how operators hold their place in that line.”


Operators can request the[MD 564 initial performance card](https://www.mdhelicopters.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026_MD564_Initial_Performance_Product_Card.pdf) , reservation terms, or a program briefing at[mdhelicopters.com](https://www.mdhelicopters.com/models/md-564/) or email MD atsales@mdhelicopters.com


All MD 564 performance figures are preliminary calculations; specifications are subject to change.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by MD Helicopters.*
